info.title: Joke App - Submit Microservice API
info.description: This microservice handles the submission of new jokes. It validates incoming jokes and publishes them to a RabbitMQ message broker for asynchronous moderation by the ETL service.

tags.name: Metadata
tags.description: Endpoints for fetching system metadata like joke categories

post.summary: Submit a new joke for moderation
post.description: Accepts a new joke containing a setup, punchline, and type. The joke is validated and pushed to the `submit` RabbitMQ queue. It will not be publicly available until approved by a moderator.

example.setup: Why do programmers prefer dark mode?

400.description: Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields

500.description: Internal Server Error - Broker connection failed

get.description: Fetches the list of all currently available joke categories. This data is served directly from a high-speed local volume cache (`types.json`), which is kept in sync by the ETL service via RabbitMQ fanout events.

200.description: A successful list of joke types

500.description: Internal Server Error - Cache file unreadable

setup.description: The premise or opening of the joke.
setup.example: Why did the developer go broke?

punchline.example: Because he used up all his cache.

type.description: The category the joke belongs to. Can be an existing type or a completely new one.
